# Abel García Pascual

> Software Engineer in Spain focused on enterprise Java development, Kotlin/Android projects and secure software engineering.

## Core profile

- Develops and maintains enterprise applications with Java 17, Spring Boot, Angular and Oracle.
- Participates in requirements analysis, technical design, implementation, testing, deployment and production troubleshooting.
- Works with REST APIs, JPA/Hibernate, complex Oracle SQL, searches, data processing, statistics and exports.
- Develops personal Android projects with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose and Media3/ExoPlayer.
- Computer Engineering graduate with a Master's degree in Cybersecurity.
- Values software that is understandable, maintainable, reliable and safe to change.

## Selected project

- UnderAnime Rebirth: Kotlin/Jetpack Compose Android application with multimedia playback, progress persistence, resume support, full-screen playback, remote update checks and automated GitHub releases. Source code is private; releases are public.

## Target opportunities

- Java Backend / Software Engineer
- Full-stack Java and Angular
- Kotlin / Android development
- Secure Software Engineering / Application Security
- Remote and international roles
